name: security-audit-skill
description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
one_liner: A recipe that turns an AI coding assistant into a security auditor: it maps out a codebase, hunts for vulnerabilities, double-checks every finding with a second AI, and hands back a clean report.
buyer: A CTO at a small SaaS company who needs a security review before a big enterprise deal but can't afford a $20k pentest firm.
business_use_cases: A freelance security consultant runs it against client codebases as the first pass, then spends billable hours only on the confirmed findings instead of manual grep-and-guess triage.
A startup runs it before every quarterly SOC 2 audit to catch obvious issues (SQL injection, missing auth checks) before the paid auditor bills for finding them.
An agency bundles it into a 'security checkup' add-on service sold alongside code review retainers to existing clients.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a flat-fee 'AI-assisted security audit' report as a productized service for small dev shops
Run it as a hosted CI check that gates pull requests, billed per repo per month

steal_this: This weekend, wrap it in a simple web form: paste a GitHub repo URL, get a PDF security report back, charge $49 per report.
